headline: Brazil November Bond Rates Top 8% Over Inflation Ahead of Rate Decision
summary: Brazil's 2032 inflation-linked bond pays inflation plus 8.03%, rising from 7.89% ahead of the central bank's upcoming rate decision.
why: Inflation-linked government bonds serve as a key benchmark for domestic borrowing costs and yield curves, reflecting sovereign risk and inflation expectations in Latin America's largest economy.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Bond yields rose ahead of the central bank rate decision.
